svg.title: Lower canopy accounts for the dawn energy gap
svg.desc: Four cell maps compare dawn light bands and fractional energy contributions. A phase chart shows that the exposure disadvantage reverses outside the focal dawn interval. Empty cells are dashes; zero means leaves are present but contribute zero.

g.text: The dawn gap is concentrated in the lower canopy
Day 152, sun phases 1–32. Cell totals include every leaf sharing that cell.
Rows increase downward; line splits rows 0–6 / 7–13. Dash = no leaf. Zero = occupied, no contribution.
Phases 65–128 precede this dawn; 33–64 follow it. Noon = 64; sunset = 128. Night bins are zero.
